enchantments.tooltip: +7 Enhancement Bonus: +7 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Greater Stone Prison: This weapon is invested with the power of the earth. On an attack roll of 20 which is confirmed as a critical hit it will attempt to turn the target to stone, as the Flesh to Stone spell. A successful Fortitude save (DC 33) negates this effect.
Cosmic: This weapon is glowing with a barely-contained magical force. It deals an additional 3 to 18 force damage on a successful hit.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
